data_semantics_correction.finding: V10/V13 active_levels is the fixed five-class value grid; attainable_levels is the role-specific contract set.
data_semantics_correction.impact: Earlier V16-B/C train and internal DP audits treated unattainable 0.95 as active for these examples. V16-C1 primary-0.90 empirical development result remains observed, but its auxiliary DP labels and complete/regret causal interpretation are not valid.

interpretation: Counterfactual expansion resolves the sparse structural feasibility coverage problem, including the four-anchor development failure class that the erroneous five-level labels hid. Fine-grained token-cost consequence signatures remain only about half covered, so the next model may test multi-anchor viability and beam survival but must not claim or optimize a fully transferable continuous cost Q-function.
required_v17b_controls: use attainable_levels whenever present and assert it is a subset of the fixed classifier grid
train on train2863 only; internal validation is the sole opening gate and consumed development is not used for iteration
use deployed plus one-hop decision-critical states; do not add hop2 based on consumed-development coverage
predict per-anchor future viability with an auxiliary exact-DP set target and optimize beam survival
defer continuous future-token-cost regression until its train-to-validation coverage is improved
keep add-only deployment, V8 initialization, frozen backbone/LoRA, beam8, and one fixed endpoint
